Hi David. 
https://github.com/vcu-swim-lab/vr-emotion-recognition/tree/main/EmotionRecognition(VR)Env

This is our unity env for emotion detection with aura. All the scripts are under Assets/Scripts

The script of interest is the "EmotionRecognitionMobilenet.cs". 

Using the mobilenetv2 onnx model, it's supposed to run inference on an image captured with a game camera in unity (then run through preprocessing and face detection), ultimately outputting a detected emotion.
